description: Deterministic external full-wave handoff for rounded-enclosure, wedge/ramp, swept-wing, and representative vehicle-door feature validation. This file defines inputs and expected filenames; it contains no electromagnetic results, and its acceptance gates remain uncalibrated engineering targets until independent results exist.

solve_contract.translation_check: A target translation r must multiply monostatic F by exp(+2jk*d_dot_r).
solve_contract.polarization_frame: radar earth-frame V/H; VH is the reciprocal monostatic cross-polarized channel

reference_convergence.rule: Converge clean and featured solves separately with the same meshing strategy. Reference-solver change must remain materially below the reconstruction error reported by the four-artifact validator.

shared_rules: Use the identical frequency, angle, polarization order, phase origin, material dispersion, far-field normalization, and time convention for all four artifacts.
The clean and featured CAD must differ only in feature-local geometry or material explicitly named by the case.
Export signed complex real/imaginary F. Never subtract or compare dBsm to form a feature delta.
Do not fit phase, amplitude, range, angle, or phase center after solving.
Use the exact same assembly surface mesh for placement preflight and for documenting outward normals.

canonical-open-gap.delta: complex OPN minus FRD from the matched feature-centered two-dimensional coupon required by the canonical wedge/wing source spec
canonical-open-gap.explicit_geometry: Remove the centered strip of PEC surface at the case width. Do not add a fitted groove depth, backing, fill, or impedance not present in the canonical source spec.
canonical-open-gap.path_direction: the ordered path in case_spec.json; reversing it requires the documented coupon-angle transformation
canonical-open-gap.tessellation: preserve every path vertex and host-normal discontinuity; segment splitting must not change the reconstructed result

circular-fastener-cap.delta: complex installed-patch minus identical clean-skin patch from a local three-dimensional solve
circular-fastener-cap.installed_geometry: 8 mm diameter, 2 mm high PEC circular cap installed into the named host skin
circular-fastener-cap.local_axes: +z is outward normal; +x is the supplied roll_ref; +y completes a right-handed frame
circular-fastener-cap.surface_matching: use the host geometry and installation in the canonical wedge/wing source spec; never substitute the isolated cap response

pec-backed-groove.delta: complex OPN minus FRD from a matched two-dimensional coupon
pec-backed-groove.coupon: locally tangent PEC skin with a centered rectangular groove of the case width and 0.004 m depth; PEC floor and walls; no open cavity behind the floor
pec-backed-groove.path_direction: the ordered path in case_spec.json; reversing it requires mirrored line-response angles
pec-backed-groove.tessellation: continuous CAD path for full wave; assembly polyline maximum chord 0.005 m and a vertex at every face/fillet transition

lossy-filled-groove.delta: complex filled-groove minus flush-PEC from a matched two-dimensional coupon
lossy-filled-groove.coupon: 0.003 m wide by 0.005 m deep groove, completely filled flush with homogeneous eps_r=4.0-j0.2 and mu_r=1.0 under exp(+jwt); PEC floor and walls
lossy-filled-groove.path_direction: the ordered path in case_spec.json; reversing it requires mirrored line-response angles
lossy-filled-groove.tessellation: continuous CAD path for full wave; assembly polyline maximum chord 0.005 m and a vertex at every curvature transition

oval-quarter-turn-fastener.delta: complex installed-patch minus identical clean-skin patch from a local three-dimensional solve
oval-quarter-turn-fastener.installed_geometry: PEC elliptical capped boss, semi-axes 0.006 m along roll_ref and 0.004 m across roll_ref, height 0.0015 m along the outward normal, intersected cleanly with the local skin
oval-quarter-turn-fastener.local_axes: +z is outward normal; +x is roll_ref; +y completes a right-handed frame
oval-quarter-turn-fastener.required_pattern_extent: full 0 to less than 360 degree local azimuth, including the exact local elevations reached by the acceptance look grid
oval-quarter-turn-fastener.surface_matching: solve the installed and clean local patches on the case-named tangent/curved skin; do not use the isolated metal boss

clean_geometry.construction: Extrude the ordered yz polygon from x=-0.400 m to x=+0.400 m and close both end caps. Preserve every hard deck/ramp edge.
clean_geometry.clean_feature_state: Continuous PEC sloped ramp and upper deck; suppress both gaps and both fastener caps.

surface_normal_contract.definition: Use exact outward planar face normals and retain the ramp/deck normal discontinuity.

clean_geometry.construction: Triangulate the listed three span stations by the three chord fractions using straight edges. Do not smooth the deliberate spanwise normal break and do not change triangle diagonals between clean and featured models.
clean_geometry.surface_rule: At each station, y=y_leading_edge-fraction*chord and z=z_skin+[0,mid_chord_camber,0] for the three chord fractions.
clean_geometry.clean_feature_state: Continuous faceted PEC skin with the hinge filled flush and no access fastener cap.
clean_geometry.mesh_identity_rule: Assembly and full wave must use identical vertices, triangle diagonals, hard edges, and global coordinates.

surface_normal_contract.definition: Use the exact outward normal of the canonical incident triangle; never average across the middle span-station crease.
surface_normal_contract.hinge_rule: For each of the two 0.64-chord hinge segments use the outward normal of its specified aft-side triangle, preserving the discontinuity at x=0.460 m.
surface_normal_contract.fastener_rule: Use the exact outward normal of the outboard forward cell's aft triangle; project that triangle's first directed edge into its tangent plane for roll_ref.

clean_geometry.construction: Closed solid rounded box centered at the global origin. Start from a 0.800 m x 1.200 m x 0.320 m box along x, y, z and apply a 0.080 m radius tangent fillet to every external edge and corner.
clean_geometry.clean_feature_state: Continuous flush PEC everywhere; no groove and no fastener boss.

surface_normal_contract.definition: Outward unit normal of the filleted solid.
surface_normal_contract.upper_right_xz_fillet: For |y|<=0.520 m, r(theta)=(0.320+0.080*cos(theta), y, 0.080+0.080*sin(theta)) m and n(theta)=(cos(theta),0,sin(theta)), 0<=theta<=90 deg.

wrapped-shoulder-loop.description: Closed service-hatch loop spanning the top plane, upper-right xz fillet, and right plane.
wrapped-shoulder-loop.orientation: ordered from top-aft to top-forward, then across the shoulder to the side and back aft
pieces: forward connector at y=+0.280 m: top x=0.220 to 0.320 m; fillet theta=90 to 0 deg; right plane z=0.080 to -0.020 m
aft connector at y=-0.280 m: right plane z=-0.020 to 0.080 m; fillet theta=0 to 90 deg; top x=0.320 to 0.220 m
wrapped-shoulder-loop.full_wave_path: Use exact straight lines and exact 0.080 m circular arcs joined tangentially.
wrapped-shoulder-loop.assembly_path: Sample straight pieces and arcs at no more than 0.005 m chord; use the analytic outward normal at every endpoint.

top-door-loop.description: Rounded rectangular closed loop on the planar top surface.
top-door-loop.assembly_path: Maximum 0.005 m chord with exact circular corner arcs.

fillet-one.local_skin: 0.080 m radius cylindrical PEC fillet with axis +y

vehicle-door-section.name: PEC representative vehicle door/body section
vehicle-door-section.material: PEC except the explicitly named filled seal

clean_geometry.construction: Closed shallow doubly-curved PEC shell. In the yz rectangle -0.750<=y<=0.750 m and -0.500<=z<=0.550 m, the outer skin is x_skin(y,z)=0.700-y^2/(2*3.000)-(z-0.025)^2/(2*4.000) m. The back is x_skin-0.120 m and the four perimeter walls close the volume.
clean_geometry.clean_feature_state: Continuous analytic outer PEC skin; the complete door path is suppressed/filled flush and all fastener bosses are removed.
clean_geometry.perimeter_edges: Keep sharp so the case retains realistic nearby diffraction.

surface_normal_contract.roll_reference: Project global +z into the local tangent plane and normalize; all listed points remain far from the singular case.

door-perimeter.description: Rounded trapezoidal door shut line on the analytic outer skin.
door-perimeter.corner_rule: Replace each polygon corner by the unique tangent circular arc of radius 0.060 m in the yz parameter plane; shorten both adjacent straight segments to the tangency points.
door-perimeter.map_to_surface: For every (y,z) sample, compute x from x_skin and compute n from the analytic normal formula.
door-perimeter.orientation: listed vertex order, with tangent fillets, then closed to the first vertex
door-perimeter.full_wave_path: Use exact yz lines/arcs mapped through x_skin.
door-perimeter.assembly_path: Maximum 0.005 m three-dimensional chord and a vertex at every line/arc tangency.

door-fasteners-eight.roll_rule: Use normalized projection of global +z into the tangent plane.
door-fasteners-eight.response_rule: Build one installed-minus-clean local patch response per position, matching the translated and rotated analytic quadratic skin over a 0.160 m diameter patch.

cases.name: wedge/ramp - paired sloped and horizontal controls
cases.feature_summary: 3 mm ramp/deck gaps and matching ramp/deck compact fasteners

parameter_sweep.value: sloped ramp plus horizontal deck control
other_values: translate ramp gap +0.025 m in x

feature_spec.explicit_feature: Use exactly the four features in the canonical source spec. The full-wave and reconstructed configurations must enable the same four IDs. Run the named translation and roll variants as required controls, not as fitted corrections.

cases.name: swept wing - hinge across normal break and access fastener
cases.feature_summary: 2 mm swept flap hinge plus one anisotropic installed access fastener

other_values: split every hinge segment in half

features.normal_rule: canonical aft-side incident triangle per segment; discontinuous at the middle station

features.location_rule: barycentric weights [0.22,0.33,0.45] on the outboard forward cell's aft triangle
features.roll_rule: project the triangle's first directed edge into the tangent plane

feature_spec.explicit_feature: Use exactly the two features in the canonical source spec. Run segmentation, direction, translation, and roll variants as required controls without changing the acceptance grid or fitting the result.
